If you click the "Watch" button in this forum you can be alerted whenever a new announcement is posted!

item.title: Hypixel SkyBlock 0.27.3 - Magic Find Rework, Accessory Bag Revamp, and more!
item.author: invalid@example.com (Hypixel Team)

item.content:encoded:
​

Hello! Today we are releasing both the Magic Find Rework and Accessory Bag Revamp to the main server. Both of these updates touch many parts of the game, so keep reading to learn all of the details!

item.title: Ravengard Q&A November 4th
item.author: invalid@example.com (Judg3)
item.dc:creator: Judg3
item.content:encoded:
Hello Ravens!!

Thank you all so much for your recent support during the Ravengard playtests!

We would like to invite you all to another Q&A session with the Ravengard team on the official Hypixel Discord.

The Q&A will be at 12:00 PM Eastern Time on November 4th!

Please note that in order to participate in the Q&A, you MUST link your account to our Official Discord! Check THIS article for more information.
